name: FWF World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Held by Submarine as of the fed's own two-year anniversary bulletin in December 1997, with Hades named the #1 contender and a Frankie Starz/Andru Edwards #1-contender's match billed for the WinteRumble III pay-per-view.

name: FWF Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Held by "The Ladies Man" Scott Girard as of December 1997, with the challenger to be decided at WinteRumble III itself.

name: FWF World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Held by the Perfectly Perfect Duo as of December 1997, billed to defend in a three-way elimination match at WinteRumble III.

name: FWF Extreme Championship
epitaph: Held by Alan Reed as of December 1997, billed to defend against Thanatos at WinteRumble III.

name: FWF/ASW Unified Television Championship
epitaph: A championship unified across two Sister Leagues members, FWF and ASW, held by "Devastating" Daniel Lewis as of December 1997 -- though the Sister Leagues' own weekly ranking the same day records the holder as disputed.
notes: FWF's own 18 December 1997 anniversary bulletin; Sister Leagues Ratings List, 18 December 1997.

name: FWF Cruiserweight Championship
epitaph: Announced vacant in December 1997, to be decided in a battle royal at WinteRumble III; no result survives in this collection's own 1997 holdings.
